notes: Somalia has NO VAT: the consumption tax is a 5% sales tax (Sales Tax Law No. 2 of 1984; Revenue Directorate rate table: 5% on imports, wholesale trade and other companies, extended to general retail in Aug 2024) - not coded in the VAT fields. Import duty 25% on all gold HS 7108 lines per the Ministry of Finance Customs Tariff 2022. No bullion-specific provision found.

sources.name: Federal Government of Somalia, Ministry of Finance (mof.gov.so) - Somali Customs Tariff 2022, ch. 71
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: every HS 7108 subheading (powder, unwrought, semi-manufactured, monetary) carries 25% duty

sources.name: Somalia Revenue Directorate (revenuedirectorate.gov.so) - Indirect Tax
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the sales tax (Law No. 2 of 1 July 1984) is charged at 5% on imports, wholesale trade and other companies; no gold-specific provision
sources.quote: Sales Tax Law No. 2 of July 1, 1984. The Sales Tax was created and mandated.
